findings.suggested_fix: State the source in CO-6. Either server.ts reads services and clock from app.locals.ctx, or it calls createContext itself and passes it into createApp. Cite app.ts#L20.
findings.text: CO-5/CO-6 have server.ts call startStaleJob(services, clock), but server.ts only gets back an Express app from createApp(pool, config). Services and clock are built inside createApp into app.locals.ctx. The design never says how server.ts gets them.

findings.text: S-6 (REQ-14, glossary entry for Stale) is served by no component. The story map just calls it 'a glossary edit outside the product repo' and names no file, owner or step for it.

findings.text: CO-4 and the trade-offs call the SCHEDULED check 'the guard'. AppointmentService already has a private method named guard that maps overlap errors to 409, so 'widen the guard' is ambiguous for implement.

findings.text: For a Stale appointment, the reschedule picker opens on the original past date: its initial date is the appointment's start day, below the input's min of today. CO-9 only widens which statuses show actions.

findings.suggested_fix: Cite render.yaml#L2 and #L9 (plan: free), and add one line noting that the startup run covers time when the instance was down.
findings.text: The trade-off rests on 'one Render instance' but cites nothing. render.yaml supports it as one free web service. The design also does not say the timer only runs while that process is up, so the startup run is what catches up after idle.

findings.suggested_fix: Use format: "one of BOOKED, RESCHEDULED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, NO_SHOW, STALE".
findings.text: EP-2 history[].event has the format 'adds STALE' rather than the full value set, so an AC cannot check the allowed values exactly.

rubric_items.reason: Built on existing layers (migration, types, repo, service, web labels). The new job's wiring into server.ts skips over how it gets services and clock, which createApp builds internally.
S-1 to S-5 and S-7 are mapped to components. S-6 (glossary, REQ-14) is only called 'outside the product repo', with no component or owner.
Endpoint fields have type, nullability, format and example. EP-2 history[].event format is just 'adds STALE', not the full value set, and the startStaleJob inputs are not pinned to a source.
Claims are cited and C9 is Assumed with 'implement must confirm'. The single-instance deployment fact in the trade-offs has no citation.
The timer, hourly cadence, single guard widening and overlap-constraint effects each come with a reason.
Readable, but it calls the scheduled() check 'the guard' when AppointmentService already has a different method named guard.
